description: dotnet new templates for TKCode.Arc: desktop and cross-platform (desktop + WebAssembly) apps with Arc's theme, fonts, Lucide icons, light/dark switching and saved preferences, in a blank, sidebar, header or dock layout, with optional MVVM, dependency injection, localization and tests (dotnet new tkcode-arc, tkcode-arc-xplat); finished sample apps for an admin back office, an AI chat client, a developer tool, a workflow editor, a project planner and an analytics dashboard (tkcode-arc-admin, -ai-chat, -devtool, -workflow, -projects, -analytics); a control library with tests and a sample (tkcode-arc-lib); and item templates for pages, windows, dialogs and Arc-style controls.
title: TKCode.Arc project templates
